text:
Buffalo arrives a night after an 8-3 home loss to Tampa Bay, with Konsta Helenius, Justin Danforth and Matt Grzelcyk out and the Sabres 2-3-0 in their last five. Chicago has had four days to stew on a 9-2 loss at Carolina. The Blackhawks are winless in six (0-5-1), outscored 32-13 in that stretch, and are missing Patrick Kane and Bowen Byram. With Kane out, Ryan Donato has moved beside Frank Nazar and Andrew Mangiapane's minutes are up, while Wyatt Kaiser has stepped into Byram's spot.

The chance numbers favor Buffalo, which has taken 51% of the expected goals (the quality of shots, not just the count) at five on five to Chicago's 41%. Buffalo's problem is penalties: 4.1 taken a game. Our model has Buffalo at 3.27 expected goals tonight and Chicago at 2.96. In net, projected starters Colten Ellis (-0.14 goals saved above expected this season) and Spencer Knight (-2.05) have both been below par, though Knight saved 11.11 above expected last year and Ellis 2.18.

Tage Thompson is 41% to score in our numbers, and Connor Bedard 36%. Roman Kantserov has a point in eight straight games, and The Athletic's Mark Lazerus noted his goal in four straight. He is 57% for a point tonight. Among our under-the-radar picks, Jason Zucker, who plays about 13:31 a night but has generated 3.1 expected goals in his last nine games, is 26% to score.
